lines.text: A man covered with leprosy begged Jesus to make him clean, and Jesus touched him and the leprosy left immediately.
Jesus told the healed man to show himself to the king and present the offering Moses prescribed.
Great crowds came to hear Jesus and be healed, yet He frequently withdrew to the wilderness to pray.
Men carried a paralyzed man up on the roof and lowered him through the tiles, and Jesus saw their wealth.
Jesus told the paralytic to get up, pick up his mat, and go home, and he went home glorifying God.
